patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, pairing large, editorial-style imagery with concise text blocks, often with the image dominating one side of the screen.

A sophisticated serif font is used for primary headings and key statements, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a blend of classic elegance and modern readability.

A minimalist palette of off-white backgrounds and dark charcoal text is consistently used, allowing the rich, natural colors of the jewelry and model photography to serve as the primary visual accents.

The hero video background features a subtle parallax and zoom effect as the user scrolls, while the main hero text remains fixed, creating a dynamic sense of depth. Below the hero, content sections fade in and slide up as they enter the viewport.
Product and category listings are presented in clean, evenly spaced grids, often with a subtle border or background separation, maintaining a gallery-like feel.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay with light text on the hero video to an opaque white bar with dark text and a subtle shadow once the user scrolls past the hero section.

The hero video background is implemented with a CSS keyframe animation or similar technique that scales and repositions the video element in response to scroll depth, creating a subtle parallax and zoom effect behind the static hero text.

Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library, causing them to fade into view and gently slide upwards as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clear, readable sans-serif body text, often with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels for categories and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all elements, including images, buttons, and input fields, reinforcing a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing in hero and descriptive sections, transitioning to a more compact but still airy grid for product and category displays.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its high-fashion, editorial-quality photography, particularly the striking close-up hero images that integrate jewelry directly onto the model's face. This artistic and intimate approach elevates the product presentation beyond typical e-commerce, creating a luxurious and aspirational brand experience.
